title: Notification that bwatch removed a stale block
description: The **bwatch_block_reverted** notification is sent once for each block removed while `bwatch` processes a chain reorganization.
Subscribers should discard or reverse every match they recorded for the given block. Its delivery count is bounded by the reorganization depth, independent of the number of registered watches.
Subscribers should handle a repeated notification idempotently after process recovery.
The height of the removed block.
The hash of the removed block.
